title: Resolution urging Congress to raise tax break for performing artists
summary: This resolution calls on the U.S. Congress to pass, and the President to sign, the Performing Artist Tax Parity Act of 2025. The act would raise the income cap for a tax deduction available to qualifying performing artists from $16,000, a figure unchanged for nearly 40 years, to $100,000 for individuals and $200,000 for joint filers. It would also tie the cap to inflation going forward.
